summary: Kingsoft Cloud Holdings Limited, a Nasdaq- and HKEX-listed cloud services issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its September 2026 Monthly Return of Equity Issuer on Movements in Securities with the Hong Kong Exchange. Registered capital held at 40,000,000,000 ordinary shares (US$0.001 par); issued shares unchanged at 4,531,784,801 with zero treasury shares. Public float compliance (25% threshold) confirmed. Only activity: 189,975 options lapsed under the 2013 Share Option Scheme, leaving 12,382,195 outstanding, with US$14,099.98 raised. No special-situation event; routine listing-rule disclosure. Watch nothing deal-related.
